select
    cast(reference_year as integer) as reference_year,
    cast(geography as varchar) as geography,
    cast(structure_type as varchar) as structure_type,
    cast(unit_type as varchar) as unit_type,
    cast(rent_value as double) as rent_value,
    cast(vector as varchar) as vector,
    cast(source as varchar) as source
from read_parquet(
    'data/bronze/cmhc/rental_market/rents.parquet'
)

select
    cast(reference_date as date) as reference_date,
    cast(cpi_value as double) as cpi_value,
    cast(series_id as varchar) as series_id,
    cast(source as varchar) as source
from read_parquet(
    'data/bronze/bank_of_canada/cpi/cpi.parquet'
)

select
    cast(reference_year as integer) as reference_year,
    cast(geography as varchar) as geography,
    cast(income_concept as varchar) as income_concept,
    cast(statistic as varchar) as statistic,
    cast(income_value as double) as income_value,
    cast(unit as varchar) as unit,
    cast(vector as varchar) as vector,
    cast(source as varchar) as source
from read_parquet(
    'data/bronze/statcan/income/income.parquet'
)

select
    extract(year from reference_date)::integer as reference_year,
    avg(cpi_value) as annual_average_cpi
from "ottawa_housing"."main"."stg_cpi"
group by
    extract(year from reference_date)::integer
order by
    reference_year

with rents as (

    select
        reference_year,
        geography,
        structure_type,
        unit_type,
        rent_value,
        lag(rent_value) over (
            partition by geography, structure_type, unit_type
            order by reference_year
        ) as previous_rent
    from "ottawa_housing"."main"."stg_cmhc_rents"

),

cpi as (

    select
        reference_year,
        annual_average_cpi,
        lag(annual_average_cpi) over (
            order by reference_year
        ) as previous_cpi
    from "ottawa_housing"."main"."int_annual_cpi"

),

income as (

    select
        reference_year,
        geography,
        income_value
    from "ottawa_housing"."main"."stg_income"

)

select
    rents.reference_year,
    rents.geography,
    rents.structure_type,
    rents.unit_type,
    rents.rent_value,
    cpi.annual_average_cpi,
    income.geography as income_geography,
    income.income_value as annual_median_after_tax_income,
    rents.rent_value * 12 as annual_rent,

    case
        when rents.previous_rent is not null
        then 100.0
            * (rents.rent_value - rents.previous_rent)
            / rents.previous_rent
    end as rent_growth_percent,

    case
        when cpi.previous_cpi is not null
        then 100.0
            * (cpi.annual_average_cpi - cpi.previous_cpi)
            / cpi.previous_cpi
    end as cpi_growth_percent,

    rents.rent_value
        / nullif(cpi.annual_average_cpi, 0)
        * 100 as rent_in_2002_cpi_dollars,

    rents.rent_value * 12
        / nullif(income.income_value, 0)
        * 100 as rent_burden_percent

from rents
inner join cpi
    on rents.reference_year = cpi.reference_year
inner join income
    on rents.reference_year = income.reference_year
